
{{alias}}( x, c, d )
    Evaluates the cumulative distribution function (CDF) for a Burr (type III)
    distribution with first shape parameter `c` and second shape parameter `d`
    at a value `x`.

    If provided `NaN` as any argument, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `c <= 0` or `d <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    c: number
        First shape parameter.

    d: number
        Second shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Evaluated CDF.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 0.1, 1.0, 1.0 )
    ~0.091
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.2, 2.0, 2.0 )
    ~0.0015
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.8, 0.5, 0.5 )
    ~0.687
    > y = {{alias}}( -0.5, 4.0, 2.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0, -1.0, 0.5 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0, 0.5, -1.0 )
    NaN


{{alias}}.factory( c, d )
    Returns a function for evaluating the cumulative distribution function (CDF)
    of a Burr (type III) distribution with first shape parameter `c` and second
    shape parameter `d`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    c: number
        First shape parameter.

    d: number
        Second shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    cdf: Function
        Cumulative distribution function (CDF).

    Examples
    --------
    > var myCDF = {{alias}}.factory( 0.5, 0.5 );
    > var y = myCDF( 0.8 )
    ~0.687
    > y = myCDF( 0.3 )
    ~0.595

    See Also
    --------
